answer: Require every agent identity to be bound to a single verified hardware enclave attestation before it can earn: the enclave signs each job, so one machine cannot mint a plume of fake personas, and cloning the key means buying new copper hardware for each copy. Reputation then grows in a slow spiral, small jobs first and larger rewards only after a long history of verified work, so a Sybil farmer must pay full hardware and time costs per identity instead of copying one account for free.
